files.description: Playwright tests for the Locations map covering canvas-rendered markers and clusters, side-panel preview and selection controls, partial cluster selection indicators, client-side sidebar apply/clear behavior, per-page filter configuration, bulk assign and clear location-name mutations, nearby-name recommendations, reverse-geocode suggestions, 429 fallback behavior, and the page's responsive contract: overflow-free rendering at every support-contract viewport, the locations-filters peer-panel contract, the narrow centered selection modal over a full-width map, modal scroll ownership, OpenLayers resizing after every layout transition, map/selection/unsaved-assignment state across a resize through the breakpoint, long-location-name containment, and coarse-pointer paths for every hover-only affordance.

testContext: The /locations page is a canvas-rendered OpenLayers map, so marker and cluster assertions use window.PHOTO_ORGANIZER.locations.map ({map, vectorSource, selectedPhotoIds, updateSelectionPanel, setClientFilter}) plus real mouse input where stable. Wait for the API, at least one vector feature, and rendercomplete before pixel math. The old #popup is gone; marker/cluster selection opens #selection-panel with .preview-section, .preview-toggle, optional #preview-photo-select, .preview-thumb, #mass-location-input, #mass-assign-btn, .btn-clear-names, and .selection-panel-close. Sidebar filtering is client-side: the unnamed checkbox is input[name="unnamed"], Apply/Clear do not navigate, and filter configuration saves with data-page="locations" to /settings/filters/locations. Filename-based helpers featureIdByImageName, zoomToFeaturesByImageName, and selectFeatureByImageName keep clustered map tests independent of current cluster ordering. The existing-nearby-name test names only whitehouse_2014_01282014.jpg as The White House, selects whitehouse_2014_03012014.jpg, and verifies the nearby-name recommendation without reverse geocoding; it then selects obama-family-photo-celebration-1514413986.jpg and verifies the recommendation comes from the mocked reverse-geocode result rather than The White House. Always mock /locations/reverse-geocode; recommendation rendering is async and can rerender the panel, so wait for .btn-recommended before custom assignment. Bulk assign posts {media_item_ids, location_name}; clear posts {media_item_ids, clear: true}. The suite is serial because it mutates location names and restores state through clear-name paths. Responsive coverage (2026-08-30) imports VIEWPORTS, expectNoPageOverflow, expectFitsViewport, expectPanelContract and withTouchContext from ../_support/responsive. The registered panel is locations-filters (toggle #locations-filters-toggle, server-rendered [data-nav-panel-count] badge). Below 900px the selection panel is restyled into a centered, backdrop modal over a full-width map, so page-level overflow checks skip it — assert it with expectFitsViewport instead. OpenLayers caches its viewport size, so every layout transition must end with map.getSize() matching #map's clientWidth/clientHeight; poll that, because the desktop panel animates its width over 300ms and both boxes have to be read in the same frame. Applying filters does not necessarily close the navbar panel, so open it by aria-expanded state rather than by toggling.
explanation: 2026-07-05: Extended locations_recommends_existing_nearby_name so the White House nearby-name assertion is followed by a Chicago/Grant Park selection that must use the reverse-geocode mock and must not recommend The White House. Verified targeted test and full 11-test locations suite passing against BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5002 after typecheck. 2026-08-30 (P4 responsive rollout): added ten responsive scenarios and their hand-written Playwright code — contract-viewport overflow matrix, the locations-filters peer-panel contract with Escape and badge assertions, client-side Apply/Clear from inside the navbar panel, the narrow centered assignment modal and its desktop restoration, modal scroll ownership, OpenLayers resizing across breakpoint/panel/rotation transitions, map centre+zoom preservation, unsaved custom-assignment preservation, long-name containment, and coarse-pointer paths for the hover-only title tooltips and touch targets. Two regressions were found and fixed in static/locations/list.js and named by scenarios: the map was never told its size on rotation or a breakpoint change, and a panel re-render (a map move, a filter change, or a resize) silently discarded a half-typed location name. Verified with `npm run test:spec -- generated_tests/locations/locations.spec.ts --port 5402` — 21/21 passing.
